issues.quote: Revenue rose 9.4% to $514.0 billion in fiscal 2022 from $338.5 billion in fiscal 2021.
issues.problem: Amazon's FY2021 revenue was about $469.8 billion, not $338.5 billion. The 9.4% growth rate only works with $469.8B; growth from $338.5B would be about 52%.

data.summary: Mostly accurate. Gross profit, operating income, net income, margins, the 108.2% decline and EPS (split-adjusted) are correct, but FY2021 revenue is wrong: it was about $469.8B, not $338.5B.
